assets.name: matching
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a standalone illustrated game-selection button object for a premium preschool Korean/English reading web app, one asset only. Style: beautifully crafted soft matte clay and layered paper 3D, tactile smooth edges, softly painted details, delicate studio lighting, restrained warm cream, coral, seafoam green, honey yellow, tiny soft contact shadow. Charm comes from the objects, no mascots. Composition: landscape-ish 4:3 bounding silhouette centered with generous transparent margin; object fills 75% of canvas, camera slightly above front at a gentle three-quarter angle. Render complete objects, no cropping. Real transparent alpha background. NOT a screen mockup, no frame, no enclosing cloud/button/banner/backplate, no giant rectangle, no wooden signboard, no badge, no label or UI text, no watermark. The object itself is the clickable illustrated choice. Strong clear silhouette, preschool friendly, clean composition, premium game art rather than emoji clipart.
Subject: A pair of oversized rounded picture-matching cards, slightly fanned apart, one showing a charming orange kitten sitting, the other showing the very same orange kitten in the same pose, to immediately communicate finding a matching pair. The cards have thick pastel mint and warm cream rounded edges, beautiful clay-relief illustrations, a small curved coral connection between them. Exactly two cards, exactly two same kittens, no letters/numbers/text. Cards themselves are the subject, no backing slab.

assets.name: blocks-en
assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied Korean clay block illustration. Keep the exact three cubes, shape, framing, cream/mint/coral colors, lighting, delicate shadow and real transparent alpha background. Change ONLY the raised Korean glyph ㄱ on the cream cube to a raised coral capital A; change ONLY the raised Korean glyph ㅏ on the mint cube to a raised dark green capital B. Keep all other pixels/ornaments/composition as close as possible. Exactly A and B, no Korean symbols left, no text elsewhere. This is an English phonics game menu asset.
